verdicts.decision_note: The client directs the financial model to use documented indicative OPEX ranges and clearly identify those assumptions for the eight-site government-submission model.
The freelancer identifies a material unresolved conflict between two program-level OPEX ranges that would produce different model calculations.

The client establishes the CAD 30–40M annual program OPEX range and directs the model not to use the conflicting Appendix amount; no prior attribute becomes stale beyond the updated assumption source.
